page_title: PSG 1-3 TOU | PSG v Toulouse 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' 1 - 3 Frank Magri (Toulouse) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball in the middle of the goal.
90+4' Toulouse work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+4' The total number of attempts is 15:17.
90+3' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is adjudged offside.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Here comes a substitution. Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) is brought on as a substitute for Yann Gboho.
86' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) sends a sweet pass into the box towards Achraf Hakimi. He looks to dribble past an opposing player, but fails and the ball is cleared.
86' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

84' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
83' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Wonderful movement by PSG. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Gabriel Suazo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Christian Mawissa Elebi (Toulouse).
79' Frank Magri (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Thijs Dallinga.
77' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
77' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Marco Asensio and he is replaced by Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Achraf Hakimi (PSG) comes onto the pitch so that Nordi Mukiele can be given a rest.
76' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Good work from PSG as they win a corner.
74' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.

71' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
71' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
68' 1 - 2 Goal! Gabriel Suazo slips it to Yann Gboho (Toulouse) on the edge of the box and he finds the right side of the net with a great effort. The score is 1:2.

67' What a big chance! Danilo Pereira (PSG) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
66' The corner is swung in but PSG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

66' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Guillaume Restes, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
66' A quickly taken corner by PSG.

66' A cross from Senny Mayulu (PSG) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' Substitution. Mikkel Desler makes way for Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
64' Carles Martinez is forced to make a change. Zakaria Aboukhlal is unable to continue due to injury, Aron Donnum (Toulouse) comes on.
64' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
63' Here is a change. Bradley Barcola is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Senny Mayulu (PSG).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ousmane Dembele (PSG) comes onto the pitch for Kang-In Lee.
62' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
60' Kang-In Lee (PSG) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
58' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.

57' A cross from the by-line finds Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
57' Great ball in from Kang-In Lee. Marco Asensio (PSG) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
56' Kang-In Lee (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
54' Danilo Pereira (PSG) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
53' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
52' Nordi Mukiele (PSG) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
50' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Carlos Soler (PSG) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. PSG get a corner.
48' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
48' Danilo Pereira (PSG) makes a rough challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
45+1' A corner kick by Toulouse is thwarted by the well prepared Arnau Tenas (PSG).
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
45' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
42' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
42' A long ball forward to Bradley Barcola (PSG) is intercepted.
41' 55:45 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
39' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
38' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
37' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

36' A long pass finds Kylian Mbappe (PSG) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
35' Referee Florent Batta sees the trip by Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
34' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
33' Bradley Barcola (PSG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
32' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
32' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Toulouse will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
30' Kevin Keben (Toulouse) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
30' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
29' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Toulouse.
28' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

26' Marco Asensio (PSG) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
26' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
24' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
24' Toulouse take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
23' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Moussa Diarra (Toulouse). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Toulouse.

22' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
21' Danilo Pereira (PSG) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Arnau Tenas has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

15' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
13' 1 - 1 It's 1:1! Moussa Diarra feeds Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the left side of the net.
12' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) commits a foul and Florent Batta immediately signals a free kick.
10' No offside! Referee Florent Batta points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the PSG players.
9' Wait! Referee Florent Batta has indicated he is going to review the PSG goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

8' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Kylian Mbappe (PSG) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 1:0. Guillaume Restes was helpless.
6' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
4' Bradley Barcola (PSG) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
3' A cross into the box from Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) is cleared.
1' The first half has just begun.
PSG will kick-off.
Florent Batta got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
